text:
rachel-hiringops: Heads-up — multiple reports of scorecards losing recent edits when two interviewers open the template at the same time. Just saw a candidate's rubric get partially overwritten after an onsite.

maya-peopleops: ugh. repro steps? is this the web UI or the CSV editor?

rachel-hiringops: web UI. Steps I saw: 1) interviewer A opens scorecard template for Panel X, 2) interviewer B opens same template ~2m later, 3) A saves, B saves, and B's save appears to revert some of A's checkbox/rating fields (not all). No error shown.

nick-recruiter: saw same last week during a heavy hiring day. Workaround was to refresh before saving and re-apply checks. Not great.

maya-peopleops: @sam-eng can you triage? sounds like a classic optimistic concurrency failure — should surface a "conflict" modal when the server version has moved.

sam-eng: I can take a look. Can you paste a minimal reproduction and the dev console error if any? Also which browsers?

rachel-hiringops: Chrome 120 and Safari on macOS. No console errors visible to the recruiter. I captured network responses — save request returns 200 but payload in subsequent GET shows older values.

ats-bot: Automated note: recent deploy to /scorecards API on 1968879000 might be related (feature flag: fast-save).

sam-eng: thanks. suspect the fast-save path writes partial fields then later reconciliation writes a compacted payload that doesn't merge arrays of checkboxes. Quick snippet of what I imagine failing (from server):

```
// failing merge example
PUT /api/scorecards/templ-123
payload: { "sections": [{ "id": "s1", "questions": [ {"id":"q1","rating":4} ] }] }
// if incoming merge does shallow replace we lose other questions
```

sam-eng: I'll run a repro and add a guard: check if client version != server version -> return 409 with current payload and show merge UI.

maya-peopleops: Sounds good. For short term, can we add a banner in the UI: "Heads-up: multiple editors may overwrite each other — please refresh before saving"?

sam-eng: yeah I can add a soft banner behind a flag by EOD. Also will add server-side 409 for concurrent edits and log occurrences.

nick-recruiter: if we return 409, can the UI auto-merge trivial diffs? e.g., union of checked tags + take latest timestamp for text fields? Would reduce friction.

sam-eng: possible; I'll add a simple field-wise merge for checkbox lists and non-conflicting scalar fields. For conflicting scalars we'll surface the diff modal.

maya-peopleops: pls also add telemetry so we can see how often this happens and which interviewer workflows hit it (panel templates vs one-off scorecards).

sam-eng: yep — adding event: scorecard.save_conflict with template_id, user_id, browser.

rachel-hiringops: Great. Can you post the PR and the temporary banner copy? I'll push an internal note to interviewers telling them to refresh before opening a scorecard until fixed.

sam-eng: will do. PR link when ready. ETA for 409 + banner behind FF: 24–36 hours. Full auto-merge with modal: next week.

maya-peopleops: thanks all. @nick-recruiter can you own the comms (short note in #interviewer-announcements and a blurb in the scheduler email)?

nick-recruiter: yep — will draft and post once I see the banner copy. :+1:

rachel-hiringops: thanks team — appreciate the quick turnaround."
